create_commit_operation_add: create a CommitOperationAdd to upload a local file or bytes content to a Hugging Face Hub repository
create_commit_operation_delete: create a CommitOperationDelete to remove a file or folder from a Hugging Face Hub repository
create_commit_operation_copy: create a CommitOperationCopy to copy an LFS file to a new path within a Hugging Face Hub repository
build_commit_payload: build an ndjson commit payload from add, delete, and copy operations for the Hugging Face Hub commit API
upload_files_to_hub: upload files to Hugging Face Hub as LFS or regular blobs using negotiated transfer mode
